code:
1. Isolate affected hosts -- do NOT power off (kills evidence)
2. ID the ransomware family via note/extension
3. Check for a known decryptor
4. Verify backups are intact AND isolated
5. Ransom-pay decision -> legal + execs + insurer only
caption: Step 4 is the one teams skip under pressure -- they assume backups are fine without checking.

code:
1. Reset mailbox creds + MFA
2. Audit for attacker-added forwarding rules
3. Review OAuth app grants on the account
4. Notify Finance NOW -- flag/claw back fraud wires
caption: BEC is financial fraud wearing a technical disguise -- Finance has to be in the loop immediately.
